name: Reveler of Song (Drone)

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Drone form (plays the hurdy-gurdy).

traits.name: Compelled Contest
traits.summary: Can't refuse a musical contest: a Performance check with an instrument (Influence) sets the save DC; failing costs 20 Psychic and a Stun.
traits.text: The reveler can't turn down a contest of skill with Musical Instruments. As an Influence action, a creature can make a Charisma (Performance) check with a Musical Instrument; the reveler must succeed on a Charisma save with a DC equal to the check's total, or take 20 Psychic damage and be Stunned until the end of that creature's next turn.

traits.name: Dancing Step
traits.summary: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it leaves an enemy's reach.
traits.text: Leaving an enemy's reach never provokes Opportunity Attacks from the reveler.

traits.name: Ensemble Form (Drone)
traits.summary: This is the Drone form: it plays the hurdy-gurdy.
traits.text: The reveler takes one form: Drone, Drum or Bell. The form sets some traits and actions and the instrument it plays (hurdy-gurdy, frame drum, handbells). This block is the Drone form.

traits.name: Droning Swarm (Drone Only)
traits.summary: A swarm of bees circles it: anyone ending a turn within 10 ft makes a DC 16 Con save or is Poisoned until the end of its next turn.
traits.text: A swarm of bees droning around the reveler. Constitution save, DC 16, each creature that ends its turn in a 10-foot Emanation around the reveler. Failure: the target is Poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Instrumental Blast
actions.summary: +8, reach 5 ft or range 90 ft, 2d8+5 Thunder.
actions.text: A blast of thunderous music, up close or from afar: 14 (2d8 + 5) Thunder damage.

summary: A fiend who fights as a musician, blasting thunder from every direction, here with a hurdy-gurdy and a cloud of poisoning bees.
